definitions.explanation: Describes someone who wants more than their fair share, or the quality of being greedy. Used both as a noun referring to a greedy person and as a na-adjective meaning greedy.

examples.japanese: {欲張|よくば}りな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われる→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{欲張|よくば}りなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Even though you've already received plenty, you're still saying greedy things.

notes:
USAGE:
{欲張|よくば}り can function as both a noun (a greedy person) and a na-adjective ({欲張|よくば}りな). It carries a mildly negative connotation but is common in everyday speech, including when teasing someone lightheartedly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欲張|よくば}りな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a greedy person)
- {欲張|よくば}りなこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say greedy things)
- {欲張|よくば}りすぎる (to be too greedy)

RELATED WORDS:
The verb ⟦{欲張|よくば}る→欲張る：15774_yokubaru⟧ means "to be greedy" or "to want too much." ⟦{貪欲|どんよく}→貪欲：08199_donyoku⟧ is a more formal and stronger term for greed.
